name: zeffect_acquire_runtime_entry_by_index
description: zEffect::AcquireRuntimeEntryByIndex returns null for -1, reuses a matching runtime entry from the free list when present, otherwise clones the runtime template and updates the fresh/recycle counters.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. Functional coverage includes the fresh allocation path, free-list reuse path, counter updates, and -1 guard.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja reconstruction and assembly for 0x4620d0 validate the -1 null return, free-list lookup by effect index, recycle-count increment before RemovePayload, matching payload return, fresh-count increment, and CloneRuntimeEntryFromTemplate fallback.

The native acquire smoke verifies the -1 guard leaves counters unchanged, fresh acquisition clones a template and discovers effectGfxData, free-list insertion followed by acquisition reuses the same entry, removes it from the list, and updates only recycleCount. zeffect_init_smoke covers the same acquisition paths through spawn/runtime callback flow.
